summary: Verified bug fix: Telegram notifications now fire on tech ponto punches (POST /api/tech/timesheet/punch). Backend tests + backend logs confirm send_telegram_notification is awaited and completes successfully (log: 'TELEGRAM DEBUG: send_telegram_notification completed' at 15:14:06 during main-agent verification; no 'Telegram ponto notification failed' warnings during our test punches). GPS lat/lon + address are stored and echoed back. Sequential in→out calculates total_hours. Frontend /tech/ponto renders 'Ponto GPS' title, all 4 action buttons, and displays punches in MARCAÇÕES DE HOJE with address + map link icons.
critical_code_review_comments: tech_extras.py:169 — await send_telegram_notification(msg) is correct; wrapped in try/except so a Telegram outage does not fail the punch. Good.
The import 'from service_orders import send_telegram_notification' inside the handler is per-request; acceptable but could be lifted to module scope for micro-perf.

background_tasks param is declared on punch_timesheet but not used — either drop it or move Telegram into background_tasks.add_task(send_telegram_notification, msg) to keep punch latency independent of Telegram API RTT (currently ~450ms per punch based on log timings).
ACTION_LABELS/ACTION_EMOJIS are recreated per call — trivial, but could be module-level constants.

rca of the issue: Prior code used asyncio.ensure_future which did not schedule reliably in FastAPI request lifecycle (loop context) — coroutine was created but often not awaited before response returned and the loop dropped it. Fix: direct 'await send_telegram_notification(msg)' inside try/except. Verified via backend logs showing full round-trip completion.
